fields: method-specific initial/final backbone and anchor tensors/hashes
assertions: Frozen shared basis actual backbone tensor hash equals independently bound initial state at every reported stage.
HT/PSB/current anchor tensors equal initial pretrained tensors; all task anchor hashes agree.
Plastic final body differs initial; stage hashes form a coherent before/after chain and match actual final tensor state.
CE routes have finite positive backbone-gradient diagnostics; current also inspect nonzero backbone Adam moments and successful update counters.
common_checks.gap: requires_grad and eval mode are not saved in ordinary state_dict; final unchanged weights alone do not prove frozen-by-construction. Check source freezer/eval policy and optimizer parameter exclusion. Weight change alone may include weight decay, so combine update/gradient evidence.

assertions: Finite arrays/tensors, expected dimensions/dtypes, symmetric Gram and native PSD/moment consistency checks.
Augmented bias coordinate count cells equalN where applicable; per-class sums/counts match expected remapped official class counts.
Restored readout is consistent with saved moments/config.
Transport anchor history is exact in frozen coordinates, while predictive current_G/C are surrogate moments; do not call the latter exact current-feature history.
common_checks.gap: Moment consistency and PSD checks cannot certify nonlinear transport assumptions or old-population accuracy.

assertions: Check that EM was enabled and executed, D is finite with allowed shape/rank, and learned covariance differs isotropic initialization when claiming noncollapsed shared-basis activity.
Nonzero D/effective rank plus update diagnostics support actual prior fitting; changing D alone can reflect a factor rotation, so inspect D@D.T when comparing covariances.
PSB basis_reset_each_tasktrue; config prior scale and iteration settings match the selected full-development candidate.
common_checks.gap: basis_updated flag or iteration count alone does not prove a nonzero basis or benefit. If it legitimately collapses, report it; this does not justify omitting the formal result or claiming successful transfer. Learning activity is not evidence of accuracy benefit.

assertions: Architecture/options exactly match selected configuration; all fixed libraries exist at selected layers with selected count/rank.
Positive successful module/backbone updates; counters and optimizer steps/moments finite and consistent.
U starts exactlyzero in source: actual nonzero final U is direct evidence of a learned module correction; inspect before/after module hash flags and nonzero Adam moments as corroboration.
Record schedule/outer_updates/episode_replay_batch_size explicitly; do not restore one policy under another.
common_checks.gap: Random initial V is already nonzero; Vnorm alone is not evidence of learning. Parameter changes do not establish module benefit, specialization or cross-task reuse; those claims need separate experiments and are not assumed by completing the main table.

assertions: Complete Python/NumPy/CPUtorch/CUDA RNG mappings retained; CUDA list matches recorded visible logical-device count,2in current environment.
Dedicated replay selection/minibatch RNGs and current episode/kind generators saved where used.
Current task-local shuffle is recreated from saved base seed+1009*task at next complete boundary; no mid-epoch resume claim.
Preserve logical-device mapping for formal exact continuation; development physical-swap gate has an explicitly bounded validation scope.
common_checks.gap: End-of-run RNG bytes alone cannot prove the starting seed; combine config and class order. Mere field presence cannot prove native-equivalent continuation; reference existing task-boundary resume/equivalence evidence.

assertions: HT/PSB/ER AdamW and cosine scheduler reset per task, so full task-boundary checkpoints need no previous-task optimizer/scheduler payload.
Frozen basis has no gradient optimizer; G/C/D/config are sufficient for its next task plus global RNG.
Current preserves both AdamW optimizer states, parameter groups, steps, first/second moments, episode RNGs, counters and schedule phase; validate actual restore against architecture.
Joint restores only a completed offline fit; no optimizer or mid-epoch resumption is implemented or claimed.
common_checks.gap: Do not flag HT/PSB/ER optimizer absence as missing recovery state, or call Joint checkpoints restartable midtraining. Current optimizer IDs are not parameter names; parameter-group binding requires source-aware validation.

assertions: Formal-only cache from fixed ER, with same actual complete data, training hyperparameters, body/head initialization, replay content, RNGs, devices and numeric policy.
All stage requests/fingerprints and saved weights validated; reconstruct prefix execution chain if a development run resumed, but formal runs must start fresh.
No development checkpoint/statistics/cached fitting features imported into formal training.
common_checks.gap: Passing protocol/metric summary does not prove reuse preconditions. A matching CE-head training schedule is necessary but not enough; preserve all native guard evidence.

assertions: Preserve selected configs/source/data/weights identity, stage logs, unrounded metrics/matrices/counts, model checkpoints and hashes.
Report actual replay, auxiliary moments/reference model/optimizer storage and training costs; reader wall/peak excludes shared gradients and must be labeled accordingly.
Checkpoint may be at an original file, verified symlink archive, or explicit SHA-verified local backup/offload pointer; check its resolved available bytes, not filename alone.
R replay stores original file paths: reproducible continuation requires the verified original dataset at a usable mapping. A model-weight backup alone is not a self-contained data bundle.
common_checks.gap: Two retired legacy/bg1 development latest files were SHA-verified locally before remote offload; checkpoint.pt.offloaded.json is a recovery pointer, not evidence of training loss. Formal and active checkpoints must be independently audited and backed up; this plan does not certify all12.

shared_basis.count_checks: n_samples=sum(counts)=N; tasks10; class counts equal official remapped counts; sum(new_samples)=N and stage ordered-ID hashes match reconstructed current class views.
shared_basis.replay: No replay object/records; all task diagnostics raw_replay_images0; persistent predictor fields contain statistics and basis, not raw-image/row-feature history.
shared_basis.rng: Outer global RNG only; deterministic numerical core has config.seed but no persistent random generator/optimizer.
shared_basis.notes: Posterior weights/intercept are reconstructed by core.load_state_dict; they are not direct checkpoint keys.

history_transport.count_checks: All historical masses equalN, class counts expected, tasks10, stage mass increments exactly unique current rows.
history_transport.optimizer_policy: New AdamW and cosine scheduler each task; task-boundary restore needs body/CEhead/analytic/replay/dedicated+global RNG, not previous-task optimizer.

plastic_shared_basis.count_checks: Transport/basis vocab/counts/tasks equal; n_samples=sum(transport.counts)=N. Basis snapshot replacement never re-adds old history.
plastic_shared_basis.optimizer_policy: Same CE task reset as HT; empirical-Bayes basis is refitted from a replaced transported snapshot with no gradient optimizer.

current_adapted.count_checks: count=sum(task_sizes)=memory.seen=N; completed_tasks10; G bias countN and C last row per-class counts. task_sizes stores image counts, not class counts.
current_adapted.readout_check: W0 equals ridge solution from frozen-anchor G/C with selected base_ridge; V finite and shaped correctly. Nonzero V alone is not a module-learning proof.
current_adapted.resident_anchor_cache_check: Cache ID set exactly retained replay sample IDs, rowshape769 and finalcoordinate1; discarded raw images are not retained via this cache.
current_adapted.optimizer_policy: Both persistent AdamW states required, including state.step/exp_avg/exp_avg_sq and param_groups; architecture/options/schedule/counters must match. Per-task shuffle generator is deterministic and boundary-recreated.
current_adapted.gap: No serialized initial module-weight hash or complete historical sample-ID ledger. Source-zero initial U plus changed flags/actual nonzero U supports training activity; full benefit/reuse remains a separate question.

er.count_checks: completed_tasks10; sum(task_arrivals)=replay.seen=N; len(task_arrivals)=len(task_class_sizes)=10; task_class_sizes all10/20; expected per-task counts derived from official labels/order.
er.optimizer_policy: Optimizer/scheduler freshly reset each task; checkpoint is task-boundary only. Validate fixed baseline role, not internal_shared_ce_driver.
er.absent_by_design: No frozen anchor, historical G/C or module library.

joint.count_checks: unique_training_images=N; selected=protocol_total_classes=C; fit_complete true; endpoint/cur_task9; ten protocol task widths but only one offline_fit_count/stage/diagnostic; training visits=N*epochs and replay visits0.
joint.ordered_ID_hash_warning: selection.fitting_ids_sha256 hashes the union grouped by remapped class, whereas manifest.fit_ids_sha256 hashes the natural full-training row order. Reconstruct the exact grouped order; do not require these two distinct hashes to equal.
joint.replay: Zero replay, all-class offline union permission; not subject to incremental history budget.
joint.optimizer_policy: Completed-fit restore only. No optimizer or mid-epoch continuation. resultAIA/forgetting mustnull, neverzero/pseudoCILcurve.
joint.dedicated_rng_fields: Global RNG is saved; the empty-replay training generator has no future use after completed Joint, so it is not a missing continuation state.

summary_tool_scope.covers: Selected main protocol, final phase eligibility, stage counts/all-seen matrices and arithmetic closure, JointFinal-only handling, internalERdriver exclusion.
does_not_independently_prove: Actual full-training sample coverage or exactly-once commits
Actual anchor immutability or plastic/basis/module learning
Actual initial pretrained source or executed code identity
Native-equivalent CE reuse or independent full training resource costs

availability_notes: Use active bounded/new current checkpoint or SHA-verified local backups; two retired legacy/bg1 latest remote files intentionally have offload pointers after verified local backup.
Completed HT/PSB checkpoints may be archived behind an original-path symlink; resolve/check actual bytes rather than misclassify archive location as data loss.
completion_rule: Execute the applicable checks against each of the12selected formal runs and retain independently tied evidence. This checklist and its limited schema probes are not evidence that12experiments have finished.
source_sha256_scope: Current review checkout for schema references only; each actual formal runtime snapshot still needs its own independently tied source identity.
